title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E8 — Great Sanford Siege
Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E9 — Coffins For Sale
Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E10 — The Barracuda
Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E11 — Tv Or Not Tv
Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E10 — George Who?
Louise insists that she and George have fallen into a rut, until a turn of fate transforms their 'routine' into the good old days.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E12 — George Finds A Father
George's Christmas is merrier after Louise's intervention helps him find a father he never knew.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E13 — Louise's Sister
A surprise for Louise turns into a shock for George after she has a strange reaction to a visit from her long-lost sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E14 — Louise's Reunion
When Louise finds out about a new clause in George's will, she almost gives him cause to use it.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E15 — The “Short” Story
Mo’s group at the Den includes a short kid known as “Biggie”.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E17 — She’s Back
A famous female broadcast journalist who used to be friends with Frank speaks at Bridgewood, so Mo invites her to their house for dinner.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E18 — Model Employee
Rather than asking Frank every time she wants something, Mo decides to get a part-time job at the Class Act where Hakeem works.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E19 — Mo’s Money, Mo’s Money, Mo’s Money
Moesha wants to get cable and her own phone now that she has a job and is making money.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E20 — This Time You’ve Gone Too Far
Mo, Kim, Hakeem, Niecy, Morgan, Marco, and Chris head off on a road trip to San Diego.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E21 — Body Language
Mo, Kim and Niecy play a game of “Truth or Dare”.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E3 — Between Friends
Mark and a former college buddy embark upon an all-out competition--first with wrestling, then with women. Vanessa finally manages to get a job answering phones at a doctor's office.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E4 — He Said, She Said
Geneva fights with the video store clerk who claims that she never returned the "Mrs. Doubtfire" tape. When Mark breaks up with a woman he was dating from Vanessa's carpool, Vanessa is kicked out.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E5 — Matinee
When he takes Nicole and her friends to the theater, Mark disrupts the movie. Geneva makes 300 penguins for the school's decoration committee.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E6 — Mo' Money
Mark almost gets fired when he buys a vending machine for the school to profit off of the sales. The bus that Vanessa is riding gets hijacked.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E7 — Instant Replay
Mark reluctantly plays basketball with former classmate Reggie Wilson (played by Indiana Pacers superstar guard REGGIE MILLER), now an NBA star. Vanessa connives to go on a date with Reggie.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E8 — House Guest
P.J. has a fight with her mother and moves out of the home they share and into Mark's home.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E9 — My Achy Breaky Back
In order to go on an important coaching interview after he hurts his back, Mark undergoes some experimental treatment for the pain at the doctor's office where Vanessa works. Series director Mark Linn-Baker ("Perfect Strangers") guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E10 — True Romance
Vanessa finds out her new boyfriend is not as rich as he wants her to believe. Tyler asks Mark for advice on girls.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E11 — Clothes Make the Man
Vanessa rescues Steve and Mark when they are tricked into buying new expensive clothes from a beautiful saleswoman who tells them they are very attractive and wants them to model in a calendar. Geneva is convinced Nicole is a future chess champion.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E12 — The Christmas Show
Mark's job as Santa at the mall and his Christmas plans at home both fail miserably, but the Christmas spirit triumphs.Christmas episode.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E8 — Moving On
Mystery and wonder are used to describe the new home George and Katherine are going to rent. This is a Victorian house replete with secret walls, openings, and more.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E9 — Thanksgiving Story
Webster, George, and Katherine are all trying to have a peaceful Thanksgiving. But things don't turn out the way they plan when George's aggressive father and Katherine's snobby mother arrive for Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E12 — Too Much Class
After Webster transfers to an advanced learning class, his grades start to slip.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E15 — Runaway
After she ran away seven years ago, Bill and Cassie's daughter returns to her parents.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E20 — What is Art?
Webster makes a mistake by accidentally recycling Uncle Phil's tin can sculpture.

description:

Mo asks Frank if she can go to a slumber party at Morgan’s house.
